high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore feed. The post is by the account "right_wing_usa," which has a profile picture featuring an American flag and a cartoon character. The main content of the post includes a tweet from Nikki Fried (@NikkiFried) that reads: "Ron DeSantis has Fox News, but we have everyone else. Florida will be blue in 2022." Below the tweet is a meme image featuring a scene from the movie "Mean Girls." The meme includes the text: "SO YOU AGREE" at the top and "YOU THINK THE MEDIA IS BIASED AGAIN
